name: Internal close and reconciliation workbook

lineage.method: Built from scratch from the blueprint-authorized abstract pattern; no source bytes, facts, formulas, names, values, identifiers, or styling were copied.

purpose: Reconcile authorized source activity to a ledger balance, document exceptions, and prepare supported close entries.
lifecycle: internal working copy through reviewed close file

slot_contract.value_source: authorized world facts or explicit role assignment only

knowledge_and_authority_constraints: Source_Data contains source-owned rows, not conclusions.
Questions and exceptions cannot supply their own resolutions.
A PASS check is internal arithmetic evidence, not approval or release authority.
Current authoritative records control over prior-period context.
prohibited_content: unresolved build tokens in instantiated artifacts
generation_notes: Populate source and mapping layers before reconciliation.
Expand reserved rows only when the producer and workflow warrant the population.
Preserve formulas, validations, number formats, freeze panes, and distinct layer styling.
The untouched candidate intentionally shows MODEL STATUS FAIL until required identity slots are replaced.

proof_expectations.description: Open as OOXML and verify all eight named sheets.
Recalculate and tie source, reconciliation, entries, and checks.
Render and visually inspect every sheet.
Reject identities, world facts, generator residue, hidden answers, and unresolved tokens in an instantiated artifact.
